'''Sephraem''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]] in a [[Mirror World]], where she served as a [[Sitter]] in the [[Hall of the Tower]] around {{ne|850}}.
== History ==
After the unexpected death of the [[Amyrlin Seat]], Sephraem tried to wrestle control from [[Elayna]] Sedai, who had been the most recent [[Keeper of the Chronicles]].<ref name="videogame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]</ref>
